name: Enhance Ability
entries: You touch a creature and choose Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. For the duration, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks using the chosen ability.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2. You can choose a different ability for each target.

omissions.mechanic: different ability choices per upcast target
omissions.reason: Spell action selections currently apply one ability choice to every selected target.
